about: Shared verdicts for a made agent's card file and stored description (agents a chat makes, step 1, D1). Run by test/made-card-parity.test.ts against src/mesh-made.ts and by packages/mesh/test/made-card.test.ts against the runner's reader. A case reads `doc` (as JSON), or `text` (as is), for the agent id `id` (default action-items), as a card file or, with `stored`, as the stored description. `fill` first sets doc[fill.key] to fill.count copies of fill.char; `pad` pads the JSON text with spaces to that many bytes. `servers` names each server servers.json holds and its kind. The verdict is "ok" with the `card` the reader returns, or the exact refusal words, which never hold a value from the file.

cases.name: the example card

doc.name: action-items
doc.description: Turns meeting notes into a list of action items.
doc.instructions: You are given meeting notes. List each action item on its own line: the task, then the owner in brackets. If there are none, say so. Do not add anything that is not in the notes.

cases.verdict: ok

card.description: Turns meeting notes into a list of action items.
card.instructions: You are given meeting notes. List each action item on its own line: the task, then the owner in brackets. If there are none, say so. Do not add anything that is not in the notes.
